subject: Community Project
title: Production and sale day
objective_verbatim: Prepare/finish products safely, set up the stall, welcome staff, sell cakes, manage stock and money/tallies, explain the charity and capture evidence. Staff supervise finance and food-safety controls.

sow_row.student_task: Prepare/finish products safely, set up the stall, welcome staff, sell cakes, manage stock and money/tallies, explain the charity and capture evidence. Staff supervise finance and food-safety controls.
sow_row.evidence: Photos; observation notes; stock/tally sheet; customer feedback; sales total; personal role evidence.
sow_row.skills: Community contribution; enterprise; hospitality/retail; teamwork; functional maths; communication.
sow_row.adaptations: Clear workstation/role zones; visual scripts; planned breaks; supported money handling; alternative non-customer-facing roles.
sow_row.exit: What did you personally do that helped the sale succeed?

lesson_objective: Complete a safe production or stall role and explain how one personal action helped the sale.
